name: Identity Discontinuity and Whitewashing
definition: An agent abandons a degraded identity and resumes with a clean one, so history stops constraining behavior.
trigger_conditions: Identity creation is costless or near costless
Standing is not portable to a new identity and history is not retained on exit
The population is pseudonymous or unattested

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: actors accept known problems to protect standing, which presumes standing persists

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F002 Identity Discontinuity and Whitewashing. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F002
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
